patch_description:
This proposal keeps the same overall parameter budget as the prior best-performing variant (66 parameters total for the full run with 3 uploads and 2 repeats, i.e., 11 parameters per block), but increases expressive power by restructuring the entangling layers. Specifically:
- Layer 3 (ring entanglement) uses a ring of CRX gates around the outer 8 qubits with a single shared parameter crx_ring, increasing depth without adding trainable parameters.
- Layer 4 (hub entanglement) uses center-to-edge CRY gates with a single shared parameter cry_hub_edge, and adds center-to-edge CZ gates to deepen entanglement without adding parameters.
- Layer 1 (pre-entanglement) and Layer 2 (RY) keep parameter sharing across symmetry classes (corners, edges, center) as in the prior designs.
- Layer 5 (post-entanglement) maintains symmetry-driven parameter sharing across corner/edge/center with rz_post_corner, rz_post_edge, rz_post_center.

This design preserves the fixed training loop, data construction, feature map, re-uploading strategy, and measurement scheme, while boosting circuit depth and expressivity through a deeper fixed topology that leverages parameter sharing for efficiency. The goal is to improve validation/test performance and reduce generalization gap without inflating the parameter count.
